observable_failure_step.description: compile_gold_standard_chapter4.py wrote 03_deliverables/Chapter_4_Results.docx with 4 latent structural defects related to BiDi configuration.

root_cause_diagnosis: The script and patches failed to enforce RTL in four layers: 1) Injected <w:bidiVisual w:val='1'> instead of empty <w:bidiVisual/>. 2) Omitted <w:bidi/> or appended it after <w:docGrid/> in w:sectPr. 3) Ignored word/settings.xml, missing <w:themeFontLang w:bidi='fa-IR'/>. 4) Omitted <w:bidi w:val='1'/> from short table cell paragraphs. The validator also permitted w:val='1', causing a blindspot.
prescribed_behavior: 1) Inject <w:bidiVisual/> as empty without w:val. 2) Ensure <w:bidi/> precedes <w:docGrid/> in w:sectPr. 3) Update word/settings.xml with <w:themeFontLang w:bidi='fa-IR'/> and compatibilityMode=15. 4) Enforce <w:bidi w:val='1'/> in <w:pPr> of all table cell paragraphs. 5) Validators must reject w:val on bidiVisual.
